title: Senior Software Engineer
summary: Lead technical delivery for business web applications. You'll help turn client needs into a workable scope, guide engineers through difficult decisions and make sure the software can be maintained after launch.
responsibilities: Design data models, integrations and permission boundaries for new features.
Break projects into reviewable releases and plan how to migrate existing data.
Mentor engineers through design discussions, code reviews and production troubleshooting.
requirements: Experience owning a production web application through design, release and support.
Ability to reason about database changes, failure recovery and operational trade-offs.
Experience guiding other engineers and communicating decisions to non-technical colleagues.
niceToHave: Experience with integrations, data migrations or multi-tenant products.
